meaning: Unfolding the two definitions: a witness of the rival (x in act in r, not in act in esse) contradicts the premise at x and r; the rival fails iff no such witness exists, i.e. iff InAct x r excludes not-InAct x esse. The registered omission model M2 (a actually hot, not in act in esse) satisfies the rival together with sensible motion, the regress premise and the other seven act/potency premises.
